name: gauge
description: Band above the prompt: turn, output speed, turn and session cost, prompt cache countdown and context fill.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last request that read or wrote it. 60 on a Claude subscription, 5 on the API by default.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before the cache expires (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: A toast and a notification when this many minutes are left, at most half the cache lifetime. 0 turns the warning off.
